contract: Finite nonmodal performances. Movement, camera, Use, quests, rewards and endings retain their owners. Wait on separation; resume unheard turns. Never conjure absent speakers.

direction_defaults.knowledge: Only the present participants' observed work and the explicit recorded conditions on this scene. A quotation is never a summoned witness.
direction_defaults.interruption: Protected dialogue, danger, weapons, menus, absence and separation suspend playback. Release all presentation and navigation ownership; resume at the last fully heard turn.
direction_defaults.consequence: Completion remembers this exchange for the journal. Existing quest work, physical aftermath and optional services retain their own state and rewards.
direction_defaults.performance: Use the named occupation, existing hand stations when in reach, restrained gesture, listener gaze and approved audio only. Subtitle-only lines do not fake speech animation.

scenes.purpose: An ordinary welcome has useful work behind it.
scenes.knowledge: Nessa knows only the kitchen shortage.
scenes.consequence: Existing flour and water work remains available.
turns: Mind the hot side. A loaf looks much the same before it burns your hand.
Which side is the hot one?
The one I told you to mind. There is water by the care bench, if Anwen needs a hand.

scenes.purpose: A warning belongs to people who can recognize it.
scenes.knowledge: The ordinary repaired mechanism is tested, not the cemetery bell.
turns: Brake. Pin. Release. The watch answered the trial.
Check it with your eyes as well. A rope can lie to your fingers.
Then I will leave the rhythm beside the post. For the ones who cannot hear it.

scenes.purpose: Company without a debt or a mandatory win.
turns: I saved you the honest cup. The other one improves my chances.
Not after I explain them. Sit, walk, lose at Three Marks. We can manage all three.

scenes.purpose: Protection has a practical offer and a cost.
turns: The renewed store would keep these blankets dry. I will not pretend that is nothing.
And the names beneath the terms?
People, not ink. Let them hear the offer before anyone answers for them.

scenes.purpose: Homecoming is care and practical work, not absolution.
turns: The road brought you back. Set the cup there; there is still work to finish.
Then do that much. The bench and the road will still be here when we have spoken.
You did not demand my oath. My refusal remains mine; it was not a threat you made.
I have come back, not to ask again.
Good. There is a cup to rinse and a bench that needs your hands.

scenes.purpose: The forest is someone's livelihood, not an enemy faction.
turns: Keep out from under that crown. Sound trunk, rotten branch.
I stopped this cut. My supper still needs a fire. Edda would remind me if I forgot.

scenes.purpose: Livelihood and stewardship disagree without an easy villain.
turns: Dry wood goes higher. Leave the wet pieces where I can see them.
So do I. I also worry about winter. Those worries fit in the same person.

scenes.purpose: The chosen watercourse needs continuing ordinary attention.
turns: The pots are clear. The screen still catches leaves. I can manage leaves.
Not everything ended with the Wretch.
No. But we can see the work now.
Your side channel keeps the work water separate. I checked the screen this morning.
Still open. Two useful things, neither needing to own the other.

scenes.purpose: A clean plot is a trial, not a magical erasure of the past.
turns: Hold the corner while I level it. It need not be beautiful.
It is still a good frame. That does not make what happened here good.

scenes.purpose: Present survival is not a denial of historical responsibility.
turns: Sound boards left. Split ones for wedges. I will not charge you for learning the system.
Who decides what goes back to work?
We should. With the old account beside the current one, not underneath it.
I have kept the rejected-load slip. Your false dispatch does not make that fee disappear.
You can still challenge the entry.
I will. That is work you added, not a kindness I owe you.

scenes.purpose: Show the actual rebuilding choice through work.
turns: Start under the new cover. Dry tools first.
And a finish to the shift?
On the list. Beside what we agreed this place is for.
The mill stays closed. We can use the shelter without pretending otherwise.
These tools are for the new work, then.
Exactly. Check the agreed use on the tray before you start.

scenes.purpose: Safety is a learned service, not ownership of passage.
turns: Stand on the pale stone. Not because it is lucky. Because it is firm.
Do you say that to everyone?
Only the ones I want to reach the other side. So far, everyone.

scenes.purpose: Hear specific competing accounts while both men are present.
turns: Someone has to keep the crossing supplied.
Rope, planks, hands. Not every name that passes us.
You know what an empty store costs.
I know. I used to count it for you.

scenes.purpose: Resolution changes passage; absent Senn is not summoned to speak.
turns: Repair pieces in this tray. The passage count has no names.
The people named on the repair rota. You can read their terms. Senn's recorded fate does not change them.

scenes.purpose: Institutions consist of people doing exact, necessary work.
turns: Cleaner is not earlier. Leave the original beside it.
And if someone asks which one to trust?

scenes.purpose: Useful authority must answer for its coercive terms.
turns: The stores opened before the frost. A command can do that while a committee is finding ink.
And when the command closes a mouth?
Then ask me about the order. Do not pretend the bread was imaginary.

scenes.purpose: Aftermath preserves source limits, including Halvern's account.
turns: I left a space for the source.
Good. A witness is not a room full of witnesses. Halvern's recorded outcome stands.
And the households can challenge their supply copies?
If we keep the reply tray reachable. Start there.
No further answer can come from Halvern.
Then do not fill the silence in his name. Keep the surviving account and its limits.
And leave the reply tray open for living people.

scenes.purpose: Living work and remembrance have room beside each other.
turns: The seed envelopes are not chisel rests.
I thought that one was empty.
It is for next spring. Empty is not useless.

scenes.purpose: A promise has a practical stopping point.
turns: The rack has an end now. I can see how much work I offered.
Yes. A stone left for tomorrow is not a broken word.

scenes.purpose: Attend to the changed grove without fabricating the Hart's presence or Kael's feelings.
turns: The choice is made. The work in this place has not ended.
The Hart is dead. No answer will come from it now. The living still have this place.
The account can leave this glade. It is not a promise made for those who hear it.
The binding is released. Care will have to be offered, not collected.
The binding remains under the chosen terms. That is an obligation to keep examining, not a final answer.

scenes.purpose: Establish shared humor.
turns: If that is another wager, carry the water first.

scenes.purpose: Remember the actual returned kettle without requiring victory.
turns: The kettle stays here this time.
I would never move a settled argument.

scenes.purpose: Workmates can disagree and still share a meal.
turns: Then the wood and I agree about something.

scenes.purpose: A cleared watercourse is visible work, not an abstract notice.
turns: Clear enough to see the bottom.
And to see when it needs cleaning.

scenes.purpose: Ordinary competence with a little teasing.
A roof and a finite shift survive the resolution.
turns: A roof with the decency to stay a roof.

scenes.purpose: Show disagreement before resolution, without inventing a fate.
turns: Two coils missing. I wrote them down.
Find the coils before you find a suspect.

scenes.purpose: Only the living, remaining captain speaks; other fates retain Tavin's return account.
turns: Rope, planks, two short shifts. That is the repair list.
No names beside the passage count. Leave it that way.

scenes.purpose: A clerk's care changes what a record can establish.
turns: A tidy copy makes it look settled.
That is why the source stays beside it.

scenes.purpose: Acknowledge the comparison without inventing testimony.
turns: You left the altered words uncovered.
I thought they had been hidden long enough.

scenes.purpose: Care includes offering permission to stop.
turns: Put the chisel down. The bed does not need a stone tonight.
I had almost convinced myself it did.

scenes.purpose: A bounded promise leaves room for ordinary life.
turns: I stopped when I said I would.
There. A promise that left time for supper.

reflections.title: Greyfen: useful hands
reflections.text: A hot loaf, a care bench, work someone was doing before Kael arrived. The missing travelers leave a place in this ordinary life.

reflections.title: Wychwood: two worries
reflections.text: Edda spoke of water and winter in the same breath. The forest supplies a livelihood; a livelihood can still damage it.

reflections.title: Deep Woods: separate accounts
reflections.text: Dain set current work beside the old account. The mill's usefulness does not settle its history. The recorded freight method remains part of this journey.

reflections.title: The Long Road: firm ground
reflections.text: Nera gave a practical reason for the pale stone. Useful guidance need not be a claim upon the person who follows it.

reflections.title: Castle Vargan: the source beside it
reflections.text: Lysa and Vale kept the source beside the cleaner copy. A useful institution must leave people able to question its account.

reflections.title: Hartlands: what remains
reflections.text: Kael stood beside the changed grove. The chosen outcome does not finish the living work.

reflections.title: Homecoming: an offered place
reflections.text: The return conversation, bench work and road reflection are complete. Kael returned to practical care. No new oath or unchosen affection has been supplied on anyone's behalf.
